summary: Fifth edition (restructured landing + admin) tested end to end. Backend: 53 pytest tests (45 existing + 8 new for iteration 11) all pass, with 1 flaky parallel test. Covered: page order, company field stored, xlsx/csv export, PNG/JPG upload to GridFS and serving, SVG rejected. Frontend (1920 and 390px): section order is correct and all removed sections/phrases are gone. Gallery has no consult buttons and the lightbox opens. Orbit shows the mala with 16 beads in a circle; click, prev/next with wraparound and 5s auto-advance work. Client carousel runs Milind→Dimple→Archana→Sunil every 5s; Archana and Sunil show monograms. Founder images change every 2s, dots work, consult button opens popup with interest set. Featured strip has 9 logos and sits right above the footer. Popup has 6 fields, defaults to +91 India and validates. Valid submit goes to /thank-you with name, 3 steps, WhatsApp and home buttons. Admin works: login, lead detail with company/profession/country, Excel and CSV downloads, all CMS sections listed, founder-name edit published to the landing page and was restored, media library upload. No horizontal overflow on mobile, no broken images, no page errors.

minor.issue: No API or UI to delete or mark media unused. QA media had to be flagged is_deleted=True straight in MongoDB, so test uploads pile up in the media library.

ui_bugs.issue: Clicking any bead, or prev/next, sets paused=true for good (useVisibleSequence 'select'). The orbit has no play/resume button (patrons do), so auto-advance never comes back until reload.
Clicking a dot does not reset the 2s interval, so the image can change again right after a manual pick.

integration_issues.issue: /thank-you opens directly without a submission (state.submitted is never checked) and shows a generic 'Thank you.' page. This could inflate conversion tracking.

issues: Country code select is narrow and cuts its text to '+91 In...'. Widen it or show only '+91' when closed.
Copy still says 'then discuss your preferred grade and finish with our team' even though the enquire buttons were removed. Optional copy tweak.

action_items: Optional: add a resume/play control for the bead orbit, or resume autoplay after N seconds idle
Optional: reset the founder interval when a dot is clicked
Optional: guard /thank-you (redirect to / when there is no submitted state) if analytics depends on it
Optional: add DELETE /api/admin/media/{id} (soft delete) plus a UI button
Optional: widen the popup country-code select
critical_code_review_comments: Landing.jsx still imports EmotionalIntro, BeadJourney, Education, Experts, Community and Enquiry and keeps them in the SECTIONS map. Removed sections come back if those keys are re-added to the order through the CMS. That may be intended, but it is dead code otherwise.
The xlsx export adds an apostrophe in front of values starting with =,+,-,@ except phone/country_code. This is good CSV/formula-injection hygiene.

Flaky: test_rudralife_iteration7_focused.py::test_inline_and_popup_enquiries_visible_in_admin_then_cleanup failed 2 of about 5 full parallel (xdist) runs and passes alone. Likely interference between tests under parallel execution; not an app bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows; 5 low-priority polish items
